explanations.title: H01 progressive search tree
explanations.conditions: Two human cells with repeats; two donor fits; retained traces from SP3-SP13 on the Vast executor.
explanations.narrative: A Hartshorne progressive search: Matryoshka family split, then inputs-against-function isolation, then the z-strategy load-curve split, before any mechanism is named. Grey branches are eliminated with the file that closed them; orange are retained; yellow are open; purple are the next tests; green are the policies.
explanations.uncertainties: Q1's phase-plane small multiples and Q3's load curves are registered but not yet drawn. The 2x2 dissection is a hypothesis about the shared function, not a result.
explanations.predictions: Q1 names elemental and cyclical as the families, structural as the shared pattern; Q3 separates in time after the spike; the dissection moves both cells with one change.
explanations.origin: H01 progressive search tree (Hartshorne splits); built 2026-09-12 from the evidence files named on each node

nodes.text: Y. Human-model contrast in the recorded spike trains of two cells (E: L2/3 pyramidal; I: PV interneuron), read against each human's own repeat envelope.
nodes.notes:
Repeat envelope at 200 pA (E): count 1 in 5 of 5 sweeps; first spike 153-209 ms (57 ms spread); threshold -54.5 to -55.2 mV; AHP -69.5 to -70.2 mV. Contrasts smaller than about 3 sigma of this envelope are not searched.
